title: Support
description: Support for the Twilightscapes apps and website.

blocks.body:
## Support

Having trouble with the Twilightscapes app for Apple TV, iPhone or iPad — or something on this site? Get in touch and include your device and what you were doing when the problem appeared.

**Email:** [support@twilightscapes.com](mailto:support@twilightscapes.com)

For how the app handles your data, see the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

items.question: Photos aren't loading in the app.
items.answer: New collections download from twilightscapes.com the first time you open them, so a network connection is needed once per collection. After that they're cached and work offline. If a download stalls, force-quit the app and reopen it.

items.question: My wallpaper download didn't appear in Photos.
items.answer: Downloads are filed into a Twilightscapes Downloads album, which requires full Photos permission. With limited or add-only access the photo still saves to your library — it just isn't filed into the album.

items.question: How do I use my downloads as a screensaver?
items.answer: On Apple TV: Settings → Screen Saver → My Photos → Twilightscapes Downloads. On Mac, the built-in photo screensavers can use the same album via iCloud Photos.
